description: Classification rules for the pinned measured FreeCAD inputs; individual SPDX and grant notices take precedence. This records evidence, not relicensing or release approval.

project_default.reason: Pinned upstream application notice explicitly states LGPL2+. Files declaring LGPL-2.1-or-later retain that narrower declaration.

src/3rdParty/lazy_loader/.reason: TensorFlow Authors' explicit Apache 2.0 grant; include the namespace initializer.

src/3rdParty/PyCXX/.reason: BSD-style grant plus the additional DOE contract notice retained in full; no simplification to plain BSD-3-Clause.

src/3rdParty/zipios++/.reason: Component grant explicitly permits version 2 or later; some component files have no separate banner.

cMake/FindEigen3.cmake.reason: The file expressly identifies its 2-clause BSD grant.

cMake/FreeCAD_Helpers/ChooseQtVersion.cm.reason: Retains the complete VTK BSD 3-clause grant.

data/examples/osifont-lgpl3fe.ttf.reason: Exact upstream multi-licence/font-exception notice retained. Unused example font excluded from production payload pending a complete font-specific packaging review.

src/Mod/Test/unittestgui.py.reason: Steve Purcell's Python-terms permission with mandatory retained copyright/disclaimer; test tool only.

src/3rdParty/lazy_loader/CMakeLists.txt.reason: FreeCAD-authored copying/build wrapper; distinct from the TensorFlow Python helper.

src/3rdParty/libE57Format/cmake/GitInfo..reason: Original C++ Modern Framework helper is MIT; libE57Format modifications retain the component BSL grant. Official MIT notice pinned separately because this copy omits its grant.

src/3rdParty/CMakeLists.txt.reason: FreeCAD's aggregate dependency-selection build script, not a vendored implementation.

src/Base/PyTools.c.reason: Mark Lutz/O'Reilly permissive use/copy/modify/distribute grant, including warranty disclaimer.

src/Base/PyTools.h.reason: The complete PPEMBED permission is in the file banner.

src/App/Expression.tab.c.reason: Expression.y grammar under LGPL2+ plus generated Bison skeleton with explicit 2.2 exception.

src/App/Expression.tab.h.reason: Generated Bison parser interface retains its explicit skeleton exception.

notes: SPDX expressions identify declared terms; multiple file declarations are retained separately and conservatively combined with AND.
The project default applies only outside src/3rdParty and only without a specific file grant; new unclassified vendored components fail.
Generated files retain measured hashes and provenance; build-host-specific output is regenerated, not expected to be byte-identical across platforms.
Files with historical GPL shorthand as well as an SPDX LGPL declaration retain both excerpts for review; the explicit SPDX declaration is the classification basis.
Dependency package copyright texts may cover unlinked code; they are not a statement that every package component is distributed.
